title: Their Own Judgment
hints: Read .claude/agents/town-crier.md — the description is technically true, but too thin for Claude to know when delegating to it actually makes sense.
A good description says what the agent handles AND when to reach for it, specifically — public announcements, not just "announcements" in general.
If your new description is still broad enough to cover ordinary requests (like listing files), it may fire when it shouldn't — that's the trap.
